messages.subject: rstan 2.9.2 - model compilation problem
parts:
Hello,

I get this error, when I run my model

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! In file included from /wehisan/general/system/bioinf-software/bioinfsoftware/R/R-3.2.4/lib64/R/library/rstan/include/rstan/rstaninc.hpp:3:0,
                 from filebae374fb7de7.cpp:427:
/wehisan/general/system/bioinf-software/bioinfsoftware/R/R-3.2.4/lib64/R/library/rstan/include/rstan/stan_fit.hpp:71:55: fatal error: stan/services/optimize/do_bfgs_optimize.hpp: No such file or directory
 #include <stan/services/optimize/do_bfgs_optimize.hpp>
                                                       ^
compilation terminated.
make: *** [filebae374fb7de7.o] Error 1
In addition: Warning message:
running command '/usr/local/bioinfsoftware/R/R-3.2.4/lib64/R/bin/R CMD SHLIB filebae374fb7de7.cpp 2> filebae374fb7de7.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 

Bw.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] rstan 2.9.2 - model compilation problem
parts:
I don't know how RStan works, but would you mind sharing
your sessionInfo(), so we can see what else is loaded.
This looks like it may just be missing the Stan headers package,
which is where that file would come from.

- Bob
